dropped_by_inner_join.note: Reproduces a real app bug: config.json's "model" field must string-match all_results.csv's "model" column for a model to appear on the displayed leaderboard at all. 'iTransformer' (CSV) vs 'i_transformer' (config.json) never match, so iTransformer is silently absent from the live table despite having full data. The 'Zeus' folder's all_results.csv contains 14 rows mislabeled as model 'GestaltCog/Zeus-100M' (no config.json matches that name, so those rows are pure orphans), leaving 'Zeus' itself with only 83/97 configs.
